name: August
summary: Peak summer thins into the year's best-kept secret: the last two weeks, as school districts return, run near-shoulder crowds with full summer operation.

verdict.short: August at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. Peak summer thins into the year's best-kept secret: the last two weeks, as school districts return, run near-shoulder crowds with full summer operation..

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The mid-August inflection is the most exploitable crowd fact on this site: identical operation to July at a fraction of its crowds, because the school calendar has moved.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Southern California holds its summer crowds slightly later than the northern parks; the stagger works in a road trip's favor.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
